title: PCSO Lotto Results: Lone Megalotto 6/45 winner bags over P115 million jackpot
summary: A Megalotto 6/45 bettor is P115 million richer after the October 16 draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Thursday evening.

blocks.text: A Megalotto 6/45 bettor is P115 million richer after the October 16 draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Thursday evening.
The winning Megalotto numbers of 08-22-19-10-35-27 unlocked a jackpot prize totaling P115,989,634.14.
PCSO said the lucky bettor purchased the winning ticket from an outlet in Camarines Sur.
Meanwhile, there was no winner for Ultra Lotto 6/58 and its P401,335,541.99 prize. The correct combination was 21-12-30-04-36-41.
